sources.title: FlashRT-HF-kernels/fp8-kv-attention/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: This package exposes the clean production-style FP8-KV path used by FlashRT: K/V are quantized when written to cache, and attention reads the FP8 cache directly. It does not re-quantize BF16 K/V inside the attention call.

sources.title: The State of FP8 KV-Cache and Attention Quantization in vLLM
